content:
maria: Heads-up — vendor just updated backlog for H100 racks. ETA vague. Can we get an interim terraform slice to carve 8 A100 slots in eu-west1 for demo next week? hitting quota on current pool. cc @ben @kai
ben: Which pool and project? we can probably spin smaller slice in demo-project but need PR + billing approval
maria: demo-project 'redwood-demo-eu', current pool id: pool-demo-eu-2. We need 8 A100-ish slots for 48h window. Also pinging procurement — @sophie any update on vendor ETA?
vendor-bot: Vendor X update: backlog estimate 3-5 weeks; partial fulfillment possible. See: https://vendor.example.com/queue/1234
sophie: Confirmed vendor still 3-5 weeks. I can fast-track a partial shipment but need SO + purchase order signed. Sending email to finance.
kai: For terraform slice — quick plan: make new resource 'redwood_gpu_slice' and set min/max. example:
```hcl
resource "redwood_gpu_slice" "eu_demo_tmp" {
  pool_id = "pool-demo-eu-2"
  instance_count = 8
  sku = "A100"
  ttl = "48h"
}
```
I'll open PR.
ben: LGTM. also need to bump project quota: `gcloud compute quotas update`? i'll file quota request ticket.
maria: @ben TY. PR link when ready? needs review by EOD tomorrow. PR should add tags and billing project.
kai: Opened PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/2345 — includes slice + docs. @ben PTAL. I'll attach smoke-test plan.
ben: Reviewing now. one comment re: eks label. will push small fix.
infra-oncall: Oncall note: if we provision early-night (22:00 UTC) I'll monitor jobs. ping me before apply.
maria: :thumbsup: thanks all. Sophie — looping finance adds time to sign? if yes we fallback to demo-project carve.
sophie: Finance OK for up to $10k without extra PO. I'll confirm by 16:00 UTC.
vendor-bot: Reminder: partial shipment requires 48h lead time once SO accepted.
maria: If finance ok, proceed with PO, then @kai apply after ben approves PR. If vendor slips, we'll use demo-project carve and mark testcase flagged in slate.
ben: Merged PR after minor fix — infra apply scheduled 22:15 UTC. tagging @infra-oncall.
infra-oncall: Got it. I'll be watching. I'll post status in the thread when done.
infra-oncall: 22:26 UTC — apply completed, 8 A100 slots provisioned to redwood-demo-eu/pool-demo-eu-2. smoke tests all green.
maria: Perfect — closing loop. I'll update demo runbook and notify product.
